plugins.name: dsh-tianshu-tui
plugins.desc: An interactive terminal UI plugin for DeepSeek Harness that adds TDD and evidence-gate workflows on top of the official harness.
plugins.desc_zh: DeepSeek Harness 的交互式终端 UI 插件，在官方 harness 基础上增加了 TDD 与证据门等工作流。

plugins.name: deepseek-harness-tui
plugins.desc: A terminal UI plugin for DeepSeek Harness that provides an interactive command-line interface.
plugins.desc_zh: DeepSeek Harness 的终端 UI 插件，提供交互式命令行界面。

plugins.name: dsh-at-file
plugins.desc: Codex-style @file mentions for DeepSeek Harness: search workspace files in the composer and attach their contents to prompts.
plugins.desc_zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 Codex 风格 @file 引用：在输入框搜索工作区文件并将其内容附加到提示词。

plugins.name: dsh-openpencil
plugins.desc: OpenPencil design preview and editing plugin for DSH.
plugins.desc_zh: DSH 的 OpenPencil 设计预览与编辑插件。

plugins.name: dsh-side-panel
plugins.desc: A DSH sidebar that integrates a file browser, terminal, and Git review for convenient file preview.
plugins.desc_zh: DSH 侧边栏，集成文件浏览器、终端和 Git 审查，方便预览文件。

plugins.name: dsh-genui
plugins.desc: GenUI for DeepSeek Harness renders interactive UI components (layout, charts, plots, forms, quizzes, mermaid, 3D scenes) inline in assistant replies via the dsh-ui fence.
plugins.desc_zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 GenUI 插件，通过 dsh-ui 栅栏在助手回复中内联渲染布局、图表、表单、测验、mermaid、3D 场景等交互式 UI 组件。

plugins.name: dsh-annotation
plugins.desc: A DSH Web selection-annotation plugin: select text, annotate, and send with your message, with bubble-hidden annotation blocks and per-annotation reply mapping.
plugins.desc_zh: DSH Web 选中批注插件：选文字、批注、随消息发送，气泡隐藏批注块，回复按 Annotation 逐条对照。

plugins.name: dsh-navbar
plugins.desc: A DSH plugin that adds a conversation-node navigation bar for quickly jumping between user messages.
plugins.desc_zh: DSH 插件：对话节点导航条，右侧节点串可快速跳转 user 消息。

plugins.name: dsh-task-status
plugins.desc: A DSH plugin that shows a background task status bar with task progress and real-time output tail on the conversation page.
plugins.desc_zh: DSH 插件：后台任务状态条，在对话页显示任务进度与实时输出 tail。

plugins.name: dsh-spotlight
plugins.desc: Keyboard-first command palette for DeepSeek Harness Web.
plugins.desc_zh: DeepSeek Harness Web 的键盘优先命令面板。

plugins.name: dsh-101
plugins.desc: A DSH plugin that provides a focused document reading mode.
plugins.desc_zh: DSH 文档阅读模式插件。

plugins.name: dsh-drag-and-drop
plugins.desc: Adds cross-platform file drag-and-drop and raw path insertion to the DSH Web UI without copying files.
plugins.desc_zh: 为 DSH Web UI 增加跨平台文件拖拽与原始路径插入能力，无需复制文件。

plugins.name: dsh-deeplink
plugins.desc: A DSH WebUI deep-link plugin that opens a project conversation directly via ?session= or ?workspace= query parameters.
plugins.desc_zh: DSH WebUI 深链插件：通过 ?session=/?workspace= 参数直接打开指定项目对话。

plugins.name: ex-setting
plugins.desc: A settings extension plugin for DSH.
plugins.desc_zh: DSH 的设置扩展插件。

plugins.name: dsh-turn-navigator
plugins.desc: Private DSH Web turn navigation plugin.
plugins.desc_zh: 私有 DSH Web 轮次导航插件。

plugins.name: dsh-milestone
plugins.desc: A Git-style milestone timeline for DeepSeek Harness: hover for metadata and click to jump to any message.
plugins.desc_zh: 会话里程碑导航条：像 Git 提交图一眼定位每条提问，悬停查看时间/轮次/耗时/TTFT，点击即跳转。

plugins.name: dsh-balance-meter
plugins.desc: DeepSeek account balance and session cost readout for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI.
plugins.desc_zh: DeepSeek Harness Web 界面的 DeepSeek 账户余额与会话成本读数插件。

plugins.name: dsh-cc-tui
plugins.desc: A Claude Code-style full-screen terminal TUI for DSH with a status line, streaming thinking, context progress bar, and TPS dashboard.
plugins.desc_zh: Claude Code 风格全屏交互终端插件：实时工作状态行、思考流式展开、上下文进度条与 TPS 仪表，补位 DSH 官方终端 TUI。

plugins.name: DSH-better-sidebar
plugins.desc: A full sidebar workbench for DSH with file render/edit, terminal, Git, sub-agent, and third-party tab registration.
plugins.desc_zh: 一个侧边栏完整工作台：内置文件渲染编辑、终端、Git、子代理，并支持三方拓展注册新 Tab 页面。

plugins.name: dsh-turn-rewind
plugins.desc: Rewinds DeepSeek Harness conversation and workspace state using a persistent change ledger.
plugins.desc_zh: 基于持久化 Change Ledger 回退 DeepSeek Harness 的对话与代码工作区状态。

plugins.name: dsh-crosstalk
plugins.desc: Cross-session messaging for DSH: any session on the machine can list and message any other, Claude Code-style.
plugins.desc_zh: DSH 跨会话消息插件：机器上任意会话可互相列出并发送消息，Claude Code 风格。

plugins.name: dsh-share
plugins.desc: A dsh conversation-sharing plugin to share your conversation with one click.
plugins.desc_zh: dsh 对话分享插件，一键分享你的对话。

plugins.name: dsh-mnemon
plugins.desc: A deep integration of Mnemon with DSH providing a complete local memory system: runtime memory, retrievable archives, and supervised memories.
plugins.desc_zh: Mnemon 与 DSH 的深度集成插件，提供完备的本地记忆系统：运行时记忆、可检索档案与受监督记忆体。

plugins.name: dsh-memory
plugins.desc: Cited memory over DSH's lossless session log: distilled, human-auditable facts with citations back to the exact source events.
plugins.desc_zh: 基于 DSH 无损会话日志的可引用记忆：提炼可人工审计的事实，并回溯引用到确切来源事件。

plugins.name: dsh-sidechain
plugins.desc: A DSH side-conversation plugin with /side persistent and /btw one-off side chats that run in a temporary fork without writing to the main session history.
plugins.desc_zh: DSH 侧会话插件：/side 持续性侧会话与 /btw 一次性侧问，在临时 fork 中运行、不写入主会话历史。

plugins.name: dsh-conversation-share
plugins.desc: Shares any selected section of a DSH conversation.
plugins.desc_zh: 分享任意段落的 DSH 对话。

plugins.name: dsh-explain
plugins.desc: A DSH local-first learning plugin with cross-session learning threads, source-based explanations, ExplainContext, compression, and diagnostics.
plugins.desc_zh: DSH 本地优先学习模式插件：跨会话全局学习线程、按来源讲解、ExplainContext、压缩与可诊断设置界面。

plugins.name: dsh-prompt-studio
plugins.desc: DSH plugin to edit user and built-in system-prompt sections with live preview (Prompt Studio).
plugins.desc_zh: DSH 插件：编辑用户与内置 system-prompt 段落并提供实时预览（Prompt Studio）。

plugins.name: dsh-chat-import
plugins.desc: Imports history messages from Claude Code, Codex, Reasonix and other agent tools to continue the conversation in DSH.
plugins.desc_zh: 从 Claude Code、Codex、Reasonix 等 Agent 工具导入历史消息，并在 DSH 中继续对话。

plugins.name: dsh-interconnect
plugins.desc: Cross-instance message and event handoff plugins for DSH (interconnect service + tools).
plugins.desc_zh: DSH 跨实例消息/事件交接插件（interconnect 服务 + 工具）。

plugins.name: dsh-plugin-claude-bridge
plugins.desc: Bridge Claude Code's memory, skills, and configuration into DeepSeek Harness with zero migration.
plugins.desc_zh: 将 Claude Code 的记忆、技能与配置桥接到 DeepSeek Harness，无需迁移。

plugins.name: dsh-plugin-meta-memory
plugins.desc: Structured long-term memory system for DeepSeek Harness with unit-based brief/full pairs and auto-inject.
plugins.desc_zh: DeepSeek Harness 的结构化长期记忆系统，基于单元的 brief/full 配对并自动注入。

plugins.name: sage-mem
plugins.desc: Cross-session memory for DSH with Chinese-first full-text search, forked from claude-mem.
plugins.desc_zh: DSH 跨会话记忆插件，中文优先全文检索，fork 自 claude-mem。

plugins.name: noatmark-dsh-plugin
plugins.desc: Text hygiene as a dsh plugin: sanitize untrusted text, scan invisible characters, clean LLM formatting, and escape CSV formula injection.
plugins.desc_zh: 文本净化 dsh 插件：清洗不可信文本、扫描隐形字符、清理 LLM 格式并转义 CSV 公式注入。

plugins.name: dsh-bash-terminal
plugins.desc: One shell tool for PowerShell / Git Bash / WSL on Windows plus an interactive PTY terminal.
plugins.desc_zh: Windows 上统一的 PowerShell / Git Bash / WSL shell 工具，附带交互式 PTY 终端。

plugins.name: dsh-vision-toolkit
plugins.desc: A DeepSeek Harness plugin that helps text-only models handle vision tasks: intent-aware image Q&A, long-screenshot OCR, UI restoration, grounding, pixel diff, and Artifacts.
plugins.desc_zh: 让纯文本模型更好做视觉任务的 DeepSeek Harness 插件：带意图的图片问答、长截图 OCR、UI 还原、grounding、像素 diff 与 Artifacts。

plugins.name: dsh-custom-tool
plugins.desc: Create and manage sandboxed JavaScript tools for DeepSeek Harness with a Monaco editor and model-driven tool lifecycle.
plugins.desc_zh: 用 Monaco 编辑器和模型驱动的工具生命周期，为 DeepSeek Harness 创建并管理沙盒 JavaScript 工具。

plugins.name: dsh-computer-use
plugins.desc: An accessibility-first macOS Computer Use bundle for DSH with fresh observations, stale-state rejection, scoped permissions, and safe input.
plugins.desc_zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供电脑控制插件：新鲜的 Accessibility 观测、过期状态拒绝、作用域权限与安全输入（目前支持 macOS）。

plugins.name: dsh-data-agent
plugins.desc: Defines a dedicated Data Agent preset that lets AI query, update, and analyze data for you.
plugins.desc_zh: 定义专用的 Data Agent 预设，让 AI 帮你查询、更新、分析数据。

plugins.name: dsh-toolkit
plugins.desc: A zero-dependency DSH tool collection: time, encoding, json, calculator, csv, regex, markdown, diff, stat, and schema — ten deterministic tools installed from one entry point.
plugins.desc_zh: DSH 零依赖工具包集合：time / encoding / json / calculator / csv / regex / markdown / diff / stat / schema 十个确定性工具，统一入口一键安装。

plugins.name: dsh-tool-csv
plugins.desc: A DSH CSV tool plugin for parsing, querying, statistics, and conversion of CSV text (RFC 4180) with a zero-dependency state-machine parser.
plugins.desc_zh: DSH CSV 数据工具插件：解析/查询/统计/转换 CSV 文本（RFC 4180），零依赖状态机解析器，注册 csv 工具。

plugins.name: dsh-tool-calculator
plugins.desc: A DSH calculator tool plugin: a safe math expression evaluator with a zero-dependency recursive-descent parser.
plugins.desc_zh: DSH 计算器工具插件：安全的数学表达式求值器，零依赖递归下降解析器。

plugins.name: dsh-tool-diff
plugins.desc: A DSH diff tool plugin for structured comparison of text/JSON/CSV/Markdown with unified diff output, zero-dependency and read-only.
plugins.desc_zh: DSH Diff 工具插件：文本/JSON/CSV/Markdown 结构化比较与 unified diff，零依赖只读。

plugins.name: dsh-tool-encoding
plugins.desc: A DSH encoding/hash tool plugin: base64/base64url/url/hex codecs, md5/sha1/sha256/sha512 hashing, and UUID generation, zero-dependency.
plugins.desc_zh: DSH 编码/哈希工具插件：base64/base64url/url/hex 编解码、md5/sha1/sha256/sha512 哈希、UUID 生成，零依赖。

plugins.name: dsh-tool-json
plugins.desc: A DSH JSON query tool plugin: JMESPath subset querying with a zero-dependency recursive-descent parser.
plugins.desc_zh: DSH JSON 查询工具插件：JMESPath 子集查询，零依赖递归下降解析器。

plugins.name: dsh-tool-markdown
plugins.desc: A DSH Markdown tool plugin: HTML-Markdown conversion, GFM table normalization, TOC generation, and a lightweight zero-dependency parser.
plugins.desc_zh: DSH Markdown 工具插件：HTML↔Markdown 转换、GFM 表格规范化、目录生成，零依赖轻量解析器。

plugins.name: dsh-tool-regex
plugins.desc: A DSH regex tool plugin: test matches, extract capture groups, safely replace, and statically explain regex without executing code.
plugins.desc_zh: DSH 正则工具插件：测试匹配、提取捕获组、安全替换、静态解释正则（不执行代码），零依赖。

plugins.name: dsh-tool-schema
plugins.desc: A DSH JSON Schema validation tool plugin: validate, paths, explain, and normalize with zero network and zero dynamic execution.
plugins.desc_zh: DSH JSON Schema 验证工具插件：validate/paths/explain/normalize，零网络零动态执行。

plugins.name: dsh-tool-stat
plugins.desc: A DSH statistics tool plugin: descriptive statistics, percentiles, frequency distribution, and correlation with zero-dependency pure functions.
plugins.desc_zh: DSH 统计工具插件：描述统计/百分位数/频数分布/相关性，零依赖纯函数确定性。

plugins.name: dsh-tool-time
plugins.desc: A DSH time tool plugin: strict ISO 8601 parsing, IANA timezone conversion, UTC calendar math, and fixed duration differences, zero-dependency.
plugins.desc_zh: DSH 时间工具插件：严格 ISO 8601 解析、IANA 时区转换、UTC 日历运算、固定时长差，零依赖。

plugins.name: dsh-kb-sieve
plugins.desc: DSH knowledge-base plugin: build auditable KB packs (references + SQLite FTS5) from md/txt/docx/pdf with deterministic retrieval (kb_query) and original-text reading (kb_read).
plugins.desc_zh: DSH 知识库插件：从 md/txt/docx/pdf 构建可审计的 KB 包（引用 + SQLite FTS5），提供确定性检索（kb_query）与原文阅读（kb_read）。

plugins.name: dsh-plugin-mineru
plugins.desc: Exposes MinerU document-parsing tools to the model, converting PDF/images/DOCX/PPTX/XLSX into structured Markdown/JSON.
plugins.desc_zh: 向模型暴露 MinerU 文档解析工具，将 PDF/图片/DOCX/PPTX/XLSX 转为结构化 Markdown/JSON。

plugins.name: dsh-cowork
plugins.desc: Read and write office documents and notebooks in DeepSeek Harness via doc_read/doc_write tools (xlsx, pdf, docx, pptx, ipynb) plus an MCP server and CLI.
plugins.desc_zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中读写办公文档与笔记本：doc_read/doc_write 工具（xlsx、pdf、docx、pptx、ipynb），另附 MCP server 与 CLI。

plugins.name: dsh-skillport
plugins.desc: Run every skill you already have — Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Gemini CLI — in DSH with SKILL.md discovery, Tier-2 conversions, find_skill search, and a skills doctor.
plugins.desc_zh: 让你已有的 Claude Code、Codex、Cursor、Gemini CLI 技能在 DSH 中运行：SKILL.md 发现、Tier-2 转换、find_skill 搜索与 skills doctor。

plugins.name: pack-agent-dsh
plugins.desc: Pack .pack.json/.pack.zip projects into .agent-pack/modpacks/ and expose skills via a workspace allow-list.
plugins.desc_zh: 将 .pack.json/.pack.zip 项目打包进 .agent-pack/modpacks/，并通过工作区允许列表暴露技能。

plugins.name: dsh-tool-search
plugins.desc: Per-agent on-demand tool discovery and progressive schema disclosure for DeepSeek Harness.
plugins.desc_zh: DeepSeek Harness 的按 Agent 按需工具发现与渐进式 schema 披露。

plugins.name: dsh-openmaic
plugins.desc: OpenMAIC for DeepSeek Harness: classrooms, slides, interactive widgets, and Socratic teaching.
plugins.desc_zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 OpenMAIC 插件：教室、幻灯片、交互式组件与苏格拉底式教学。

plugins.name: dsh-scholar
plugins.desc: Academic assistant plugin: search and summarize research papers from arXiv, OpenAlex, and PDF files.
plugins.desc_zh: 学术助手插件：搜索并总结来自 arXiv、OpenAlex 与 PDF 文件的研究论文。

plugins.name: dsh-apple-mode
plugins.desc: An Apple-style mode plugin for DeepSeek Harness.
plugins.desc_zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 Apple 风格模式插件。

plugins.name: dsh-continual-evolve
plugins.desc: A continual self-evolution plugin for DeepSeek Harness: versioned, auditable, rollback-safe harness state refined from session trajectories with a benchmark-driven validation loop.
plugins.desc_zh: DeepSeek Harness 的持续自我进化插件：从会话轨迹提炼版本化、可审计、可回滚的 harness 状态，并带基准驱动的验证循环。

plugins.name: dsh-recommend
plugins.desc: A transparent ranking and recommendation plugin for the DSH plugin ecosystem: daily scraping of the dsh-plugin topic, public scoring model, and ranking/recommendation site.
plugins.desc_zh: DSH 插件生态透明排行与推荐：每日自动抓取 dsh-plugin 话题 + 公开评分模型 + 排行/推荐插件与静态站。

plugins.name: modlens
plugins.desc: The first vision plugin for DeepSeek Harness and the vision bridge for every text-only coding agent: paste an image and get structured JSON evidence (OCR, layout, semantics).
plugins.desc_zh: DeepSeek Harness 首个视觉插件，也是纯文本编码 Agent 的视觉桥梁：粘贴图片即返回结构化 JSON 证据（OCR、布局、语义）。

plugins.name: dsh-find-plugin
plugins.desc: Find DSH plugins inside the agent with live GitHub dsh-plugin topic search and star-ranked results.
plugins.desc_zh: 在 Agent 内搜索发现 DSH 插件：实时 GitHub dsh-plugin 话题搜索，按 star 排行。

plugins.name: dsh_workflow
plugins.desc: Brings Claude Code's UltraCode mode to DSH, upgrading one-off multi-agent scheduling into a generatable, savable, governable, observable, and recoverable workflow layer.
plugins.desc_zh: 把 Claude Code 的 UltraCode 模式带给 DSH，将一次性多 Agent 调度升级为可生成、可保存、可治理、可观察、可恢复的 Workflow 层。

plugins.name: dsh-automation
plugins.desc: A DSH automation plugin that runs coding tasks in fresh Agent sessions on a schedule, with schedules created and managed by users or Agents.
plugins.desc_zh: DSH 自动化插件：让 Coding 任务按计划在全新 Agent Session 中运行，并由用户或 Agent 创建和管理定时任务。

plugins.name: dsh-routines
plugins.desc: Scheduled agents for DSH: run a prompt on a cron and get the digest where you already are (file digests, chatnode delivery, unattended-safe).
plugins.desc_zh: DSH 定时 Agent 插件：按 cron 运行提示词，并在你所在之处获取摘要（文件摘要、聊天节点投递、无人值守安全）。

plugins.name: dsh-plannotator
plugins.desc: A DSH plan-review plugin for anchored annotations and structured Agent feedback.
plugins.desc_zh: DSH 计划批注插件：选中计划原文、逐条批注，并把结构化反馈送回 Agent。

plugins.name: dsh-loop
plugins.desc: A DSH plugin for scheduled loops with a /loop command, loop tool, and an active status bar.
plugins.desc_zh: DSH 插件：定时循环（/loop 命令 + loop 工具 + 活动状态条）。

plugins.name: dsh-sentinel
plugins.desc: Condition-driven wakeup for DeepSeek Harness: durable file/command/http/process/webhook watches that wake the agent, with dock, sidebar branch, and a global dashboard.
plugins.desc_zh: DeepSeek Harness 的条件驱动唤醒插件：持久的文件/命令/http/进程/webhook 监听唤醒 Agent，附带 dock、侧边栏分支与全局仪表盘。

plugins.name: dsh-deep-research
plugins.desc: An adaptive deep-research orchestrator plugin for DeepSeek Harness (official workflow engine, cybernetics/information-theory design).
plugins.desc_zh: DeepSeek Harness 的自适应深度研究编排插件（官方 workflow 引擎，控制论/信息论设计）。

plugins.name: dsh-inspect
plugins.desc: An adversarial closed-loop plugin for checkup, fix, and review: a check/fix/review toolset built on the official workflow engine.
plugins.desc_zh: 发现问题（checkup）→ 修复交付（fix）→ 质量复查（review）的对抗式闭环插件：基于官方 workflow 引擎的检查/修复/复查工具集。

plugins.name: dsh-track
plugins.desc: A DSH Track Bridge plugin: an embedded task-management engine with decision-point protocol, idea capture wall, Linear-style issue storage, and AI-human task tracks.
plugins.desc_zh: DSH Track Bridge 插件：嵌入式任务管理引擎——决策点协议、念头捕获墙、Linear 形 issue 存储，AI 与人之间的任务轨道。

plugins.name: dsh-advisor
plugins.desc: Pairs a second model that passively reviews each turn and injects notes into the conversation.
plugins.desc_zh: 搭配一个副模型，在每轮对话被动注入见解和审查。

plugins.name: dsh-open-in-vscode
plugins.desc: Open DeepSeek Harness workspace directories in VS Code directly from the web GUI.
plugins.desc_zh: 直接从 Web 界面在 VS Code 中打开 DeepSeek Harness 工作区目录。

plugins.name: dsh-notification
plugins.desc: Desktop notifications for DeepSeek Harness turn completions, with per-outcome controls and include/exclude keyword rules.
plugins.desc_zh: DeepSeek Harness 轮次完成的桌面通知，支持按结果控制与包含/排除关键词规则。

plugins.name: dsh-acp-for-bitfun
plugins.desc: A plugin for BitFun to interact and integrate with DSH via ACP.
plugins.desc_zh: BitFun 与 DSH ACP 交互对接插件。

plugins.name: dsh-chatnode-wechat
plugins.desc: Chat with, monitor, and approve your DSH agents from WeChat via an iLink gateway plus conversation-node bundle.
plugins.desc_zh: 通过 iLink 网关 + 对话节点 bundle，从微信与 DSH Agent 对话、监控并审批。

plugins.name: dsh-web-ui-notify
plugins.desc: Adds desktop notification reminders to DSH.
plugins.desc_zh: 为 DSH 增加桌面通知提醒。

plugins.name: dsh-webbridge
plugins.desc: Integrates DSH with Kimi WebBridge.
plugins.desc_zh: 将 DSH 与 Kimi WebBridge 结合。

plugins.name: dsh-context-doctor
plugins.desc: A DSH context-injection audit plugin that measures token cost of AGENTS.md instruction chains, skill catalogs, and tool schemas, detecting duplicates and conflicts.
plugins.desc_zh: DSH 上下文注入审计插件：统计 AGENTS.md 指令链/技能目录/工具 schema 的 token 成本，检测重复与冲突；含 Web UI 圆环面板与 context_audit 工具。

plugins.name: dsh-plugin-check
plugins.desc: A DSH plugin health-check tool that scans manifest protocol, patch format, build traps, and hub listing status of plugin repos, zero-dependency and read-only.
plugins.desc_zh: DSH 插件健康检查工具：扫描插件仓库的清单协议 / patch 格式 / 构建陷阱 / hub 收录状态，零依赖只读。

plugins.name: dsh-security-audit
plugins.desc: A DSH local security-audit plugin that reports on config, plugin sources, sessions, and network exposure with read-only, redacted risk reporting.
plugins.desc_zh: DSH 本机安全审计插件：检查配置/插件来源/会话/网络暴露面，输出只读脱敏风险报告。

plugins.name: dsh-session-health
plugins.desc: A DSH session health-check plugin that performs frame-level diagnostics on multi-frame zstd session files to detect torn/corrupt/empty sessions.
plugins.desc_zh: DSH 会话健康检查插件：对多帧 zstd 会话文件做帧级扫描诊断（torn/损坏/空会话检测），零依赖只读。

plugins.name: dsh-trace
plugins.desc: A DeepSeek Harness telemetry backend that exports turns, model steps, and tool calls to yiTrace over HTTP.
plugins.desc_zh: DeepSeek Harness 遥测后端，通过 HTTP 将轮次、模型步骤与工具调用导出到 yiTrace。

plugins.name: dsh-llm-fallbacks
plugins.desc: A dsh plugin for role-based LLM retry and fallback strategy.
plugins.desc_zh: 基于角色的模型重试备用策略插件。

plugins.name: dsh-polyglot
plugins.desc: The model switch for DSH: a generic OpenAI-compatible ctx.llm adapter, curated free/cheap DeepSeek presets, and automatic provider fallback on rate limits.
plugins.desc_zh: DSH 的模型切换器：通用 OpenAI 兼容 ctx.llm 适配器、精选免费/低价 DeepSeek 预设，以及限流时的自动供应商回退。

plugins.name: dsh-tool-approval
plugins.desc: Manual approval for DeepSeek Harness (aka Manual Mode / Ask Mode).
plugins.desc_zh: DeepSeek Harness 的手动审批（又称 Manual Mode / Ask Mode）。

plugins.name: plugin-template
plugins.desc: A plugin template repository created from the original Turtle UI official repository.
plugins.desc_zh: 基于原 Turtle UI 官方仓库创建的 plugin 模板仓库。

plugins.name: dsh-tps
plugins.desc: A simple TPS (tokens per second) display plugin for DSH.
plugins.desc_zh: 一个简单的 TPS（每秒 token 数）显示插件。

plugins.name: dsh-fail-logger
plugins.desc: A DeepSeek Harness plugin that auto-records tool failure causes across all execution modes, deduplicates, counts, and deterministically sorts them into a skill maintenance log so the agent makes fewer mistakes over time.
plugins.desc_zh: DeepSeek Harness 插件：自动记录所有执行模式的工具失败错因，去重、计数、确定性排序后沉淀进 skill 的维护实录区段，让 Agent 越用越少错。

plugins.name: oh-dsh
plugins.desc: A one-stop DeepSeek Harness community distribution unifying TUI, desktop, and Web UI experiences with layered installation.
plugins.desc_zh: 一站式 DeepSeek Harness 社区发行版：TUI、桌面端与 Web UI 三种形态统一体验，支持分层安装、一步到位。

plugins.name: dsh-annotate
plugins.desc: Visual browser element annotation for DeepSeek Harness, capturing DOM, styles, accessibility data, comments, and viewport screenshots.
plugins.desc_zh: DeepSeek Harness 浏览器元素标注插件，捕获 DOM、样式、可访问性数据、评论和视口截图。

plugins.name: dsh-prompt-profile
plugins.desc: Reusable Markdown prompt profiles for DeepSeek Harness with per-turn model selection, argument substitution, and state restoration.
plugins.desc_zh: DeepSeek Harness 可复用 Markdown Prompt Profile，支持单轮模型选择、参数替换和状态恢复。

plugins.name: dsh-revdiff
plugins.desc: Native interactive Git diff review for DeepSeek Harness with structured annotations sent back to the current Agent session.
plugins.desc_zh: DeepSeek Harness 原生交互式 Git diff 审查，支持结构化批注并回传当前 Agent 会话。

plugins.name: dsh-gomoku
plugins.desc: Play Gomoku against AI in DSH, or have two AIs play each other to see which is stronger.
plugins.desc_zh: 在 DSH 中与 AI 下五子棋，也可以让 AI 对局，看哪个 AI 棋力更强。

plugins.name: dsh-stock-market
plugins.desc: A DSH stock market plugin that solves the bug of your account not being able to lose money while you code.
plugins.desc_zh: DSH 股票行情插件：有效解决写代码时账户不能同时亏钱的 BUG。

plugins.name: dsh-emoji
plugins.desc: Adds custom inline emoji to DSH replies.
plugins.desc_zh: 为 DSH 的回复加入自定义的行内表情。

plugins.name: dsh-minigames
plugins.desc: A DSH Web UI side-panel with 18 offline mini-games (dino jump, Tetris, tank battle, minesweeper, 2048, sudoku, Pac-Man, and more) and an extensible game registry.
plugins.desc_zh: DSH Web UI 右侧小游戏面板：18 款离线小游戏（恐龙跳一跳、俄罗斯方块、坦克大战、扫雷、2048、数独、吃豆人等），可扩展游戏注册表。

plugins.name: dsh-stickers
plugins.desc: DSH WebUI sticker plugin for bidirectional user and agent reactions.
plugins.desc_zh: DSH WebUI 贴纸插件，支持用户与 Agent 双向表情回应。

plugins.name: whale-girl
plugins.desc: A desktop-pet plugin for the DSH Web GUI: a floating, draggable companion in the corner that you can feed and play with.
plugins.desc_zh: DSH Web GUI 桌面宠物插件：右下角悬浮、可拖拽/投喂/玩耍的积累型伙伴。

plugins.name: dsh-plugin-d399
plugins.desc: Pops up a mini-game menu while the model generates (Wordle/Match-3/192 parametric mini-games, extensible registry).
plugins.desc_zh: 模型生成时右下角弹出小游戏菜单（Wordle/消消乐/192 款参数化小游戏，可拓展注册表）。

plugins.name: dsh-auto-chess
plugins.desc: An auto-battler (auto chess) plugin inside DSH Web for human-vs-AI or AI-vs-AI matches.
plugins.desc_zh: DSH Web 里的自走棋插件：人机对战或双 AI 对弈。

plugins.name: dsh-douyin
plugins.desc: A DSH WebUI sidebar short-video plugin with a native player, series navigation, direct-link parsing, and precise history replay.
plugins.desc_zh: DSH WebUI 侧栏短视频插件：原生播放器、系列导航、直链解析与精确历史回放。
